info.name: SHOP.CO E-commerce API
info.description: Laravel API v1. Run 'Customer login' or 'Admin login' first: the token is saved in a collection variable. Set base_url if your API is not on http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1. Demo accounts are in the README (password Password@123).

request.description: Public. With a customer token it also returns `viewer` (can_review, own review).

item.name: Cart (guest token or customer)
item.description: Guests send X-Cart-Token (saved automatically). Logged-in customers send the Bearer token; the guest cart is merged on login.

item.name: Customer auth
item.description: The email link /auth/email/verify/{id}/{hash} is signed and opened from the email, so it is not in this list.

request.description: Only the address is sent. Prices and totals are calculated on the server.

item.name: Write or update my review (buyers only)

request.description: With 2FA on, the response has two_factor_required and a challenge instead of a token.

item.name: Stripe webhook (called by Stripe, signature required)
